description: Photo-composite meme placing well-known U.S. political and intelligence figures behind prison bars. Recognizable faces include Robert Mueller, John Brennan, Barack Obama, Hillary Clinton, Huma Abedin, James Clapper, James Comey, Loretta Lynch, Eric Holder and Bill Clinton. The caption asserts that 'Russia collusion' is a 'proven lie' and asks when treason trials will begin — a rhetorical claim by the meme, not an established fact.
text: NOW THAT RUSSIA COLLUSION IS A PROVEN LIE, WHEN DO THE TRIALS FOR TREASON BEGIN?
flags: Meme's claim that Russia collusion is a 'proven lie' is an unverified partisan assertion
A few background faces are not confidently identifiable

description: Photograph of Donald Trump's January 20, 2017 presidential inauguration at the U.S. Capitol, shot from behind the platform looking down the National Mall at the assembled crowd, with Trump walking down the blue-carpeted aisle toward the podium. A red caption 'WE ARE Q!' has been added above the photo, framing it as a QAnon slogan image.

Screenshot of a White House Office of the Press Secretary statement dated September 17, 2018, announcing President Trump's directive to declassify portions of the June 2017 Carter Page FISA application, FBI interview reports concerning Bruce Ohr and the Carter Page FISA applications, and to release unredacted text messages of James Comey, Andrew McCabe, Peter Strzok, Lisa Page, and Bruce Ohr relating to the Russia investigation.
text: THE WHITE HOUSE. Office of the Press Secretary. FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE. September 17, 2018. Statement from the Press Secretary. At the request of a number of committees of Congress, and for reasons of transparency, the President has directed the Office of the Director of National Intelligence and the Department of Justice (including the FBI) to provide for the immediate declassification of the following materials: (1) pages 10-12 and 17-34 of the June 2017 application to the FISA court in the matter of Carter W. Page; (2) all FBI reports of interviews with Bruce G. Ohr prepared in connection with the Russia investigation; and (3) all FBI reports of interviews prepared in connection with all Carter Page FISA applications. In addition, President Donald J. Trump has directed the Department of Justice (including the FBI) to publicly release all text messages relating to the Russia investigation, without redaction, of James Comey, Andrew McCabe, Peter Strzok, Lisa Page, and Bruce Ohr. ###. -----
orgs: Office of the Director of National Intelligence

description: Screenshot of a verified @realDonaldTrump tweet dated May 20, 2018, in which Trump says he will officially demand that the Department of Justice investigate whether the FBI/DOJ 'infiltrated or surveilled' his campaign for political purposes and whether such requests came from within the Obama administration.
text: Donald J. Trump @realDonaldTrump. Following. I hereby demand, and will do so officially tomorrow, that the Department of Justice look into whether or not the FBI/DOJ infiltrated or surveilled the Trump Campaign for Political Purposes - and if any such demands or requests were made by people within the Obama Administration!. 12:37 PM - 20 May 2018
